# Third-party notices

The pinned `scsonic/MNN` source tree (commit
`1965a2632b9d1197dff2ef364d307e40c150a5c7`) includes the license files below.
They are retained from that tree under `licenses/mnn/`; filenames are prefixed
with the original directory to avoid collisions.

| Vendored notice file | Original MNN source path |
|---|---|
| `licenses/mnn/lic__flatbuffer_license` | `3rd_party/lic/flatbuffer_license` |
| `licenses/mnn/lic__skia_license` | `3rd_party/lic/skia_license` |
| `licenses/mnn/lic__tensorflow_license` | `3rd_party/lic/tensorflow_license` |
| `licenses/mnn/rapidjson__license.txt` | `3rd_party/rapidjson/license.txt` |
| `licenses/mnn/half__LICENSE.txt` | `3rd_party/half/LICENSE.txt` |
| `licenses/mnn/protobuf__LICENSE` | `3rd_party/protobuf/LICENSE` |
| `licenses/mnn/flatbuffers__LICENSE.txt` | `3rd_party/flatbuffers/LICENSE.txt` |

`arm64-v8a/libc++_shared.so` is copied from Android NDK `29.0.14206865`.
The corresponding LLVM toolchain notice is retained as
`licenses/NDK-29-toolchain-NOTICE.txt`.

This notice records source-tree licenses; it is not a claim that every listed
component is linked into the prebuilt MNN binary. See `README-MCA.md` for the
runtime binary provenance and the separate Qwen model-weight license.
